completion.source: Reused from G2_90d: generic actuator settle bounds (joint/linear position and velocity, stable window, arm TCP and IK accuracy); the prismatic gripper minimum tolerance mirrors the revolute one in metres. Fixed base: no chassis standstill limits.

frame_contract.runtime_source: arx.urdf gripper_<side>_center_fixed origin (gripper base = arm end); arx solves both arms in base_link, which realizes the arm_base_link contract frame. TCP orientation is the arm-end orientation, not the URDF center link's per-side rotation.

left.max_opening_source: user-provided physical measurement, 2026-09-28: maximum opening between the fingertips
left.source: Composed robot.usda PhysicsPrismaticJoint limits (active joint drives, passive joint is its physxMimicJoint). open/closed are the public gripper states used by training data and evaluation (-3.5 open .. 0 closed); public = active joint metres * public_state_scale (benchmark gripper_scale -3.5/0.044), so the raw joint opens at 0.044 m. No jaw aperture calibration exists, so the sample carries no aperture evidence.

ik_solver.source: No Lula description for this robot: planning uses the float64 URDF chain of arx/arx.urdf checked against the vendor ik_solver FK, with bounded least-squares IK steps.
